bagPolicy.summary: Hard Rock Stadium allows clear plastic bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small bags or fanny packs up to 4.5" x 6.5". Bag searches will be conducted using X-Ray technology or by hand.
allowed: Clear plastic bags that do not exceed 12" x 6" x 12"
Small bags or fanny packs that do not exceed 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: All purses or bags that exceed 12” x 6” x 12”
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags are permitted and subject to search.

parking.note: Parking at the stadium is sold out, but Park & Ride passes are still available. ADA parking is available in both inner and outer lots, with mobility assistance offered in outer lots. Wheelchair escorts are available from stadium gates to seating locations.

rideshare.note: Use Lot 44 at Betty T. Ferguson Recreational Complex for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Allow about 30 minutes to walk between the lot and the stadium.

concessions.note: Hard Rock Stadium offers a diverse range of food options including American, Tex-Mex, Japanese, and more. Highlights include mobile ordering at select locations and a cashless payment system. Unique offerings feature upscale dining and international cuisines.
stands: Avo Eats by Avocados from Mexico

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair escorts are available from the gates to your seat and back; ask any stadium employee or the nearest Guest Experience Headquarters, from gate opening until about 30 minutes after the event. If you park in an outer lot (Yellow Lots 14, 15/16, 18 or Gray Lot 40), call Guest Experience at (305) 943-8000 for a mobility assistance shuttle.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Hard Rock Stadium has a no re-entry policy for most events, including Dolphins and University of Miami football games.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticketmaster will call is at the South Ticket Office. Bring photo ID, your confirmation number, and the credit card used to buy the tickets. Cash is not accepted at the box office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Dolphins games, stadium gates open two hours before kickoff; for University of Miami games, 90 minutes before. Gate times for other major events vary, so check HardRockStadium.com or your event page.
